page.notes: The "»" marks at the start of each line are printer's line ornaments, not text, and are left out. The running head is set in heavy decorative type and I could not read it. The word "fin gulari" is printed with a broken word at the line end and no hyphen, read as "singulari"; the first letters are doubtful. The catchword "pro" is at the foot and is not repeated in the text. Printed "compositũ" and "cõmuni" keep their tilde as printed.
